AMENDMENTS LXXXIX-XCIV TO THE
CONSTITUTION OF THE FEDERATION OF
BOSNIA AND HERZEGOVINA
“Official Gazette of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina”, 63/03
NOTE: Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina was published in the “Official Gazette of
the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina”, 1/94.

Pursuant to Amendment L to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Parliament
of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, at the session of the House of Representatives held on
December 1, 2003 and session of the session of the House of Peoples held on December 3, 2003 adopted
DECISION ON PROMULGATION OF AMENDMENTS LXXXIX-XCIV TO
THE CONSTITUTION OF THE FEDERATION OF BOSNIA AND
HERZEGOVINA
I
Amendments LXXXIX-XCIV to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina are hereby
promulgated, adopted by the Parliament of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, at the session of the
House of Representatives held on December 1, 2003 and session of the session of the House of Peoples held
on December 3.
II
Amendments LXXXIX-XCIV to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall enter
into force at midnight, December 3, 2003.
III
This Decision shall be published in the Official Gazette of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina.

Pursuant to Amendment L to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, the Parliament
of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, at the session of the House of Representatives held on
December 1, 2003 and session of the session of the House of Peoples held on December 3, 2003 adopted
AMENDMENTS LXXXIX-XCIV TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE
FEDERATION OF BOSNIA AND HERZEGOVINA
AMENDMENT LXXXIX
Article III .1a) of the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, amended by Amendment
VIII to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall be amended to read as follows:
“a) conclusion of military agreements pursuant to the Constitution of Bosnia and Herzegovina; and
cooperation with Standing Committee for Military Matters and Council of Ministers of Bosnia and
Herzegovina and other institutions at state level responsible for military and defence matters.”
2

AMENDMENT XC
Article IV.B.3.7.a) (II) of the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, amended by
Amendments XIII, LVI, LXXII, and LXXXVIII to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and
Herzegovina shall be deleted.
AMENDMENT XCI
Article IV.B.3.8 of the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall be deleted.
AMENDMENT XCII
Article VII .1 of the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, amended by Amendment
XVII to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall be amended to read as follows:
“International relations of the Federation shall have to be in accordance with continuity, sovereignty,
territorial integrity and international personality of Bosnia and Herzegovina, according to Article III of the
Constitution of Bosnia and Herzegovina”.
AMENDMENT XCIII
Article VII .4 (1) of the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, amended by Amendment
XIX to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall be amended to read as follows:
“ (1) The treaties and agreements with states and international organizations shall be signed in the name of
the Federation by the Federation President. They shall only enter into force for the Federation only if ratified
by the Parliament of the Federation, with the prior approval of the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and
Herzegovina, except to the extent that the Parliamentary Assembly of Bosnia and Herzegovina provide by
law that these types of international treaties and agreements do not require such approval.”
AMENDMENT XCIV
Article IV.A.5.20. (1) e) of the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, amended by
Amendments X and LXIX to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina shall be deleted.
